- Home: 0700 dirs, 0600 files via `OpenOptionsExt::mode` (pinned `bin/<version>-<hash>/viola` is 0700); every replaced file goes through the one helper `viola_state::fs::replace_private` (tempfile `persist`), which sets the temp file's mode before any byte is written; the pinned `viola` is never replaced: its absent copy goes through `viola_state::fs::place_private_new` (mode 0700 set before any byte, `sync_all`, the write handle closed, then `persist_noclobber`, never over a present name), and a copy another start placed first is re-hashed before reuse, different bytes left as found. Strict-modes check (mode/owner, ssh StrictModes style) at every entry point that reads `snapshot.json`, `ledger/stamps.json` or `statusline_command`, before its first read or open under the home (`run`, `revive`'s start and `verify` through `check_home_tree` before their log opens, exit 1; `viola list`'s `board::scan` through `check_read` on the home (a home another user may read refused with or without an instance), `check_path` on `instances/` and `check_instance` per instance, the whole board refused, exit 21; the frame verbs through `check_instance`, exit 21; the diagnostics opens through `check_diagnostics`, a refusal a failed open), refusing also a home, instance directory or `diagnostics/` another user can read (any group or other bit, `mode & 0o077 != 0`) and a symlinked `diagnostics/` folder or file, and in `viola plugin install` on its home and each existing `marketplace/` tree dir before anything is created or opened (exit 21); `marketplace/` is no trusted file and its installed `command` is not re-hashed (`marketplace/` is off the integrity set).

- `viola list` (chunk 2026-10-11-the-board-viola-list) is a strict-modes entry point: `board::scan` holds the home to the read rule (`check_read`; a home another user may read is refused with or without an instance), `instances/` to `check_path` and each instance to `check_instance`, before any file under the home is opened; a failure refuses the whole board with exit 21, no log and the home's mode as found (the founder's own answer, 2026-10-13, relayed verbatim by the Viola overseer). Since chunk 2026-10-16-unwrapped-sessions-on-the-board it reads `claude agents --json` once per run after `board::read` (a direct spawn of `claude` resolved by `run::resolve_program` from its current directory, under the R8 strip, stdout through `take(MAX_FRAME + 1)`, killed at 5 s, parsed tolerantly by `viola_agent_claude::agents::parse`; a failed, oversize or malformed read leaves the board as `board::read` gave it, STATUS `unknown`, no unwrapped row; an unwrapped row's `name` is never a `ViolaName` or `target`), joins paths only from a parsed `ViolaName`, follows no link, and escapes every control character of a row (`escape_row`). It reads `budget.json` through the one checked read `read_budget_stamped` and decides nothing on it. Every CLI verb, `list`, `run` and `revive` included, and the hidden `viola mcp` (chunk 2026-10-17-mcp-server-for-drivers) (`hook` keeps its own shape check), resolves its home through `resolved_home` since chunk 2026-10-17-cli-machine-contract: `--home`, else the `instance_of` home when `VIOLA_NAME` passes `ViolaName::try_new` and `VIOLA_DIR` is an absolute `<home>/instances/<name>` (a failing pair falls through, never refuses), else `<user home>/.viola`, then `canonical_home` canonicalises a path that exists and creates nothing; the `VIOLA_DIR` step and the canonicalisation, `mcp`'s use of them included, widen what chooses a CLI verb's home: a widening the founder ratified (his own word, relayed verbatim by the operator, 2026-10-19).

- **Integration:** crate `tests/<topic>.rs` + root `tests/{cli,hook,tui,channel,chaos,contract,security_negatives}_<topic>.rs` (sync, tokio-free; shared helpers in `tests/support/` — the `events.ndjson` reader, its wait, the session-start boot and the one error-body check `error_body_hit` and `assert_error_body_clean` (classes `absolute-path` · `caused-by` · `serde-path` · `planted`, reporting place and class, never bytes) in `events.rs`, the started-child guard and runner in `cli.rs` (with `spawn_on` / `viola_on`, which put a planted bin dir on the child's `PATH`; a plain `spawn` of `list` runs with `PATH` set to an empty bin dir, so no test reads the host's `claude` sessions), `empty_bin`, `claude_bin` and `claude_in` in `fake.rs`, the one place a test plants the fake agent as `claude` (a test that plants more than one fake-agent copy plants every copy, each recorded set's bin, one after another before any thread starts a child: on the tmpfs `target/e2e-home` the hard link fails, so each copy is written, and a child one thread forks inherits another thread's open write handle, ETXTBSY), the home-widening helpers `widen` · `grant_read` · `unwiden` · `still_widened` in `home.rs` (Unix modes), through which a root test widens or read-grants a home path, restores it and reads whether it is still widened, the test-owned socket root in `home.rs` (`SOCKET_ROOT_VAR`, `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR`; `SocketRoot`, `Wrapper::boot_on_socket_root` and `first_life_on`, the last there and not beside `first_life` in `start.rs`), the one complete-lines reader in `ndjson.rs` (every reader of a live-appended file parses only newline-terminated lines), the shared start setups in `start.rs` (`first_life`, `wait_session_start_hooks`, `made_dir`, `stopped_life`, `remove_dir_once_free`, `plant_agents`, `listed`, `revive` and `kill_wrapper`), the SGR parser `sgr_attributes` (with `redraws` and `sets_a_foreground`) in `sgr.rs`, its self-check case staying in `tests/cli_output_plain.rs`, the one freeze guard `Frozen` in `frozen.rs` (`attach(pid)` and `Drop`: `kill -STOP`, `ps -o stat=` polled until `T` within `WITHIN`, and `kill -CONT` on drop), and a root test file defines no copy of its own) with `std::process::Command` and jsonschema 0.57.0; each fixed string is pinned by a literal in its test file.

| Error types | thiserror 2.0.20 (one enum per crate; `viola-pty`'s `PtyError` is hand-written; `viola-mcp`'s `ServeError` beside `McpError` and `viola-state`'s `StampsError` beside `StateError`, with `PinError`, `StampsReadError` and `Refused`, are the five ratified exceptions); anyhow 1.0.104 (bin edge only). Panic detail backtraces are raw, never-symbolised frames (root bin `src/panic_frames.rs`: libc `backtrace` + `dladdr`) | Typed errors that callers can branch on; context chains built at dispatch and recorded only in the owner-only instance detail file |

- Dev-deps: rstest 0.27 · tempfile 3.27 · insta 1.48.0 · jsonschema 0.57.0 · proptest 1.11.0 (+ proptest-derive 0.8.0, arbitrary 1.4.2) · mockall 0.15.0 · mock_instant 0.6.1 (in no manifest yet); in `viola-e2e`: rmcp `=3.4.1` (`client` alone, never `transport-child-process`), tokio 1.53.3 (`rt` + `process`, architecture.md's [Module Boundaries]); and, as ordinary dependencies of the harness, syn `=2.0.119` and proc-macro2 `=1.0.107` (`span-locations`).
- None of its own in 0.1.0: the cli cases drive the `viola` binary through `std::process::Command`, the tui cases use the tests' portable-pty pin; the browser a11y tooling left with the browser leg.

- Prompt text reaches viola only from stdin or `--file`, never from a leading-slash argument. [corrected 2026-11-06: the Git Bash reason left with the Windows code; the rule stands on architecture [CLI Conventions]]

title: 2026-11-06 — A live round on this host cannot raise a permission dialog from a shell command

data.head: ## 2026-11-06 — A live round on this host cannot raise a permission dialog from a shell command

body:
The Linux dev host's Claude Code user settings allow `Bash(*)`, so a shell command in a live session never draws a
PermissionRequest: a live plan step that needs viola's dialog path to hold a permission dialog gets none. At chunk
2026-11-06-version-done-check the live hold was driven through a question dialog instead, on the overseer's technical
answer. A live plan that needs a dialog reads the host's permission settings first and plans the dialog kind they
leave reachable.

body:
The version done-check of viola 0.1.0 on Linux: every gate green, ci#42288148289 on 849aad18 seven jobs green on ubuntu-latest, pre-push coverage suite 3367 passed 0 failed.
The dependency move: portable-pty =0.8.1 to =0.9.0 (nix 0.28.0, the serial crate family and pin-utils gone), deny.toml ignore list emptied (RUSTSEC-2017-0008 gone, RUSTSEC-2026-0441 closed); crates/viola-pty compiles unchanged, pty_backend stays openpty.
Remnant sweep in 47 files: the Git Bash rewritten-path warning of viola send retired (its emitter, unit table and CLI witness), plain_drive and its Windows verbatim-drive handling removed, every EXE_SUFFIX join and .exe trim gone; no verb, flag, env var, log field or event kind added.
One new contract test, dialog_drift_names_a_changed_annotation (a11y n/a); the HELP literal and both help tests byte-identical.
The live round: viola verify read red 23 pass 1 fail on the statusline-rate-limits row (the row reads the account plan, not the CLI); the dialog hold unread; v1-27 deferred to 0.2.0 on the founder word, the hold ceiling stays PROVISIONAL owned by 0.2.0 first entry; Epoch 7 PROVISIONAL items confirmed by the founder.

The portable-pty pin moved =0.8.1 to =0.9.0: every a11y-plan line naming the inherited =0.8.1 outer-PTY boundary driver (the tui reach row fct-4ktfiloi in §4, fct-twqx5x46 in the detail) now reads =0.9.0; pty_backend stays openpty and the outer-PTY e2e binaries are green on 0.9.0.

Any a11y-plan rationale or caveat for the old pin (Windows garbage-read, ConPTY EOF, the portable-pty swap trigger, pin-utils or the serial crates) is retired with the pin; the deny.toml ignore list is now empty.

The trycmd / assert_cmd wording of the harness contracts (keys a11y-testing-tool-pick, keyboard-test-harness, bootstrap-phases in §3) and the §8 verification lines is the plan entry 12 amendment: re-worded to the literal pins (CARRY 1), the strings pinned by literal rather than by a trycmd file.

Indirect through CARRY 1: the trycmd mentions in §2 pyramid rows, §4 P2 / P6 scenarios, the cli tool-reach row and the §9 stage row (assert_cmd 2.2.2 + predicates 3.1.4 + trycmd 1.2.1) follow the same literal-pin re-wording.

The Git Bash rewritten-path warning, the only stderr line viola send wrote on a rewritten path, is retired: any a11y-plan inventory of send stderr lines, fixed CLI strings or warnings that names it, or a Git Bash / Windows-path reason for the stdin-or-file-only input rule, is stale; the stdin / --file input rule itself stands.

plain_drive and its Windows verbatim-drive handling, the EXE_SUFFIX joins and the .exe trim are removed; any a11y-plan mention of Windows, macOS, ConPTY or .exe binary names is a remnant now (the matrix is ubuntu-latest only).

The dialog hold ceiling stays PROVISIONAL (the hold was not read live); its owner is re-pointed from the Version done-check to 0.2.0 first entry: the one hold-ceiling row in a11y-plan (the dialog hold among the time bounds of §8 Timeout extensions) follows.

The Epoch 7 PROVISIONAL items are confirmed on the founder word (socket-directory pair wording, the board read rule, chunk 2026-11-01-unix-endpoint-and-home-hardening P5 word and leans, the answer-card confirm): the one epoch7-prov row in a11y-plan loses its PROVISIONAL or OPEN mark.

v1-27 is deferred to 0.2.0: its live clauses (cli_verified true and no viola byte on screen) were not read; the tui zero-viola-bytes boundary stays proven by the fake-agent and outer-PTY tests and the unverified live run, any a11y-plan line citing a live verified proof of that boundary for 0.1.0 is stale.

The statusline-rate-limits ledger row is disproved as a CLI behaviour: it reads the account plan state, so viola verify can read red (23 pass 1 fail) on an unchanged CLI; the budget pause and status-line deadline in §8 Timeout extensions rest on that row, its owner is 0.2.0 (finding F-06i).

viola verify step-line output re-read live on 2.1.287 as [21/24] statusline-rate-limits fail and stamped 2.1.287 23 pass 1 fail: the §4 / §1 P6 verify step-line format [NN/NN] pass or fail is unmoved; the capability ledger stays 24 rows.

CI re-read: ci#42288148289 seven jobs green on ubuntu-latest (test job gate tools, G2, G4, secret scan, gate verdict); the test job gate --require coverage,doctest and the single instrumented coverage suite are unmoved; nightly.yml last run success 2026-11-02 and carries no a11y step.

.config/nextest.toml timing comments re-worded from three runners to the ubuntu reading, and coverage.rs / mutants.rs comments only: the a11y cases still run in the coverage suite and the epoch-boundary mutation audit, nothing moved.

The tui passthrough, wheel and chaos feed-panic test files were edited only for remnant lines: the boundary assertions (zero viola bytes, keystrokes unblocked past the atomic paste, focus / mouse / resize not moving the wheel, the contained feed panic) are unchanged.

The live child fd table and socket modes were read (fds 0 to 2 on the pty, socket directory 0700, socket 0600), and the killed-wrapper leg read the child gone 0.401 s after SIGKILL; the founder-attended tab-close leg and the terminal-reply hypothesis (CSI ? 6 n, kitty graphics) are carried to 0.2.0 unmeasured: an a11y-plan line on terminal replies passing through stays as a rule, unmeasured live.

The A11y tier Standard (1), the triggered and not-triggered trigger lists (visual-discrimination, keyboard-only, screen-reader-priority; wcag-mapping, regulated-compliance, cognitive, motion, multi-language, target-size): no trigger input moved.

The viola list caption order NAME LIVE STATUS WHEEL DIALOG CLI and its CAPTION literal, the UNWRAPPED READ-ONLY separator and the --help group labels: the HELP literal and help tests are byte-identical, no list column moved.

The ARIA landmarks N/A inventory, the critical paths P2 / P3 / P4 / P6 and their WCAG SC stand-ins (2.1.1, 1.3.2, 1.4.1, 3.2.4, 3.3.1, 3.3.3): no surface, verb or refusal added or removed apart from the send warning.
The refusal layout unable reason detail then hint:, the unknown exit 14 no-hint exception, the hint-free --json and the answer / send exit-2 paths: no refusal, reason code or exit code changed.
The manual Orca screen-reader passes (GNOME Terminal for cli, foot on Hyprland for tui) and their founder ownership: not exercised or changed by this session.
The frontend deferral to 0.2.0 and its unchosen technology, the no browser a11y leg, and the ban on a new suite value such as a11y: unchanged.
The §11 anti-pattern bans (no WCAG conformance claim, no spinners, no retry-once, no soft SLO, no screen-content parsing of the claude TUI): no rule changed.
The §12 Decisions Log pointers to a11y-plan-amendments.md and its archive: no a11y decision taken this session.

body:
The version done-check for 0.1.0 on Linux: portable-pty moved from =0.8.1 to =0.9.0 (nix 0.25.1 to 0.28.0; serial2 and cfg_aliases added; pin-utils, the serial family, ioctl-rs, memoffset 0.6.5 and termios removed), so RUSTSEC-2026-0441 is closed and the deny.toml ignore list is now empty (RUSTSEC-2017-0008 removed).
The Windows remnants left the tree (47 files): plain_drive and its verbatim-drive strip, the Git Bash rewritten-path warning in send (its emitter, its unit table and its CLI witness), every EXE_SUFFIX join and the .exe trim. No verb, flag, env var, channel method, log field or event kind was added; HELP is byte-identical.
One new contract test, dialog_drift_names_a_changed_annotation: a planted change to a forwarded annotations byte reads dialog_drift red.
The live round on claude 2.1.287 read viola verify red, 23 pass 1 fail, on statusline-rate-limits. The row reads the account's plan (five_hour unknown, only seven_day), not the CLI. The founder deferred v1-27 to 0.2.0, and the dialog-hold ceiling stays PROVISIONAL, now owned by 0.2.0's first entry.
The founder ratified the five one-enum divergences as named exceptions (T1). Measurement B is recorded as known, with no action in 0.1.0. Epoch 7's four PROVISIONAL items are confirmed. The fd-inheritance mechanism reads that portable-pty closes every inherited descriptor in the child.
CI ci#42288148289 on 849aad18 was green on all seven jobs. The GATES census is unchanged at 41 rows, 39 functions and 2 files.

[PTY] decision (fct-omwrdnlc) and the stack line (fct-zegjs5rw), along with fct-ad44nn2e and fct-kxiazeyf: portable-pty =0.8.1 becomes =0.9.0. The rationale changes from 0.8.1 being spike-proven, with a move owed to the Version done-check, to an exact pin like every other third-party version. The pin-utils delta is done, and pty_backend stays openpty.

fct-co2wsjkw is retired: the PTY swap trigger (the portable-pty-psmux path) is spent, because 0.9.0 drops pin-utils upstream. fct-6oxorhgk is re-read on 0.9.0, and viola-pty compiles unchanged with comment edits only.

The stack-and-technologies detail and any dependency-graph citation: nix is 0.28.0; serial2 0.2.39 and cfg_aliases 0.1.1 are added; pin-utils, serial, serial-core, serial-unix, serial-windows, ioctl-rs, memoffset 0.6.5 and termios are removed.

Supply-chain claims, including the ci-cd-approach key and the 4 architecture rows naming pin-utils: RUSTSEC-2026-0441 is closed (cargo tree -i pin-utils finds no package). The deny.toml advisories ignore list goes from 1 entry to 0, and the RUSTSEC-2017-0008 entry for serial is removed.

[Error Handling] fct-sha7o35z, the Rust error types convention fct-nhsg4k7g and the Inherited Defaults errors line fct-vf75c7sp (also fct-xqkfyxga, fct-ekks4dfz and fct-kekl3p46): the open divergences (ServeError, StampsError, and the PinError, StampsReadError and Refused the census added) become ratified named exceptions (T1), alongside PtyError.

The thiserror census (fct-gctodeyz, and the count in fct-nhsg4k7g): the grep reads 10 rows. The 10th is crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/mod.rs:25, which is test-only. The rule is reworded to cover the product sources only, and the count stays 9.

[CLI Conventions] fct-nvft5tqc and fct-onw4pywk: the sentence saying viola warns on a Git Bash rewritten-path prefix is retired, along with its Git Bash rationale, because send no longer writes that stderr line. The stdin or --file rule and the ban on leading-slash arguments stand.
[Hook Transport] fct-zhr3wx2i: part of its rationale is that exec form skips Git Bash path rewriting. That Windows reason is gone; shell startup remains the live reason.

The cross-cutting config detail (crosscut-config fct-k6htnrfj): the Windows verbatim-drive clause leaves with plain_drive. canonical_home keeps its signature, and tests/support/home.rs resolved loses its verbatim-prefix strip.

The dialog-hold ceiling in [Hook Contract] fct-4nt6qtyp, config.json fct-i4wacyrp, config.v1.json fct-6e4hf2ai, fct-vxml3b56 and fct-wpbp4hte: the ceiling stays PROVISIONAL because the hold was not read. Its owner changes from Version done-check to 0.2.0's first entry.

[Deployment / Distribution] fct-c3wssf3l and fct-wtlwpexy: Measurement B (two files whose loaded sections are equal, keying two copies) is recorded as known, with no action in 0.1.0. The pin re-hash stays the guard, and the owner wording naming the Version done-check route entry goes.

The capability ledger rows (fct-qwpklckh) and [CLI Version Compatibility]: on an unchanged CLI 2.1.287, the statusline-rate-limits row measured red (23 pass 1 fail). It reads the account's plan state, so it no longer stands as a pure CLI behaviour. The ledger stays at 24 rows, and the dev home's stamps are not moved.

[Budget Governor] fct-3hy3yfb4: the budget-paused refusal rests on the statusline-rate-limits row, which reads the account's plan. The reach is indirect, through that row. The founder's question of why viola leans on the user's status line goes to 0.2.0's intent (F-06i).

The project-directory-structure contract key (fct-irhgihut): its seven pointer lines ending in removed, recoverable at the tag multi-os-final are removed, along with its cmd/*.toml trycmd line (F434, a whole-fact edit).

The Epoch 7 PROVISIONAL marks (11 architecture rows of the epoch7-prov pattern) are discharged on the founder's own word, dialog 6/7. They cover the socket-directory pair's wording, the board's read rule, the P5 word and leans of chunk 2026-11-01-unix-endpoint-and-home-hardening, and that wrap's answer-card confirm.

Test-binary names in the test inventory and the root test support: every EXE_SUFFIX join becomes the plain names viola, claude and decoy-hook. The registered paths bin/claude and target/perf/release/viola are unchanged. The harness test is renamed exe_is_the_plain_name_in_the_dir.
The OS-gated test census (crosscut-os-gated-tests and fct-fa2klbw5): re-read and unchanged at 41 rows, 39 gated functions and 2 gated files. A re-read, not a move.
v1-44's always-admit survivor stands as the version's known limit. Three master sites name this entry as owner (fct-upolcsa3, fct-cz5jn5fs, fct-ocdr3xdn) and take the epoch-boundary audit instead.

The live round on the Linux dev host re-witnessed several standing claims, all unmoved. process-start pty_backend reads openpty. The socket directory is 0700 and the socket 0600. The pinned copy lives under bin/ and plugin/<key>/ is written at start. The child holds no viola endpoint fd. After the wrapper's SIGKILL the child was gone in 0.401 s. An unverified CLI's hook.dialog is replied null at once.

Harness and test comments only, with no rule moved: run/coverage.rs (the COVERAGE_IGNORE regex trees are byte-identical), run/mutants.rs, secret_scan.rs, session.rs, supervise.rs, and the three-runner timing comments in .config/nextest.toml, now the ubuntu reading. The other remnant tests (crates/viola-e2e/tests cli.rs, harness_lifecycle.rs, mcp_recorded_exchange.rs, path6_budget_harness.rs; tests cli_fake_agent.rs, cli_list.rs, cli_wait_last.rs, cross_list_rows.rs, run_cli.rs, tui_passthrough.rs, tui_wheel.rs) lost Windows wording or EXE_SUFFIX only.

OPEN — whether the budget gate stays and what it stands on, given that it rests on the user's status-line rate_limits payload (the founder's question, finding F-06i) · owner: 0.2.0's intent.

The contract test tests/contract_fake_agent_drift.rs::dialog_drift_names_a_changed_annotation plants a change to a forwarded annotations byte of synthetic_dialog_set and requires dialog_drift to read red.

body:
The version done-check of 0.1.0 on Linux: every gate green (ci#42288148289, seven jobs, on 849aad18), the open caps ruled, no product surface added (no verb, flag, env var, channel method, log field or event kind; the HELP literal and help tests byte-identical).
Dependency move: portable-pty =0.8.1 to =0.9.0 (nix 0.28.0, serial family and pin-utils gone), deny.toml advisories ignore list emptied, RUSTSEC-2026-0441 closed; pty_backend stays openpty.
Retired the Windows remnants: the Git Bash rewritten-path warning (send no longer writes its stderr line; emitter, unit table and CLI witness removed, the founder's T2), plain_drive and its verbatim-drive handling, every EXE_SUFFIX join and .exe trim; binaries are the plain names viola, claude, decoy-hook.
Added one contract test, dialog_drift_names_a_changed_annotation; measured a live round: viola verify read stamped 2.1.287 23 pass 1 fail, the statusline-rate-limits row red because the account status-line payload carries five_hour unknown and only seven_day, so the row reads the account plan, not the CLI.
Founder rulings: v1-27 and v1-11, v1-21, v1-34, v1-36 deferred to 0.2.0; Epoch 7's four PROVISIONAL items confirmed (socket-directory pair wording, the board read rule, a P5 word and leans, an answer-card confirm) and their marks lifted; the near-ceiling hold stays PROVISIONAL, owned by 0.2.0's first entry; why viola leans on the user status line goes to 0.2.0 intent (F-06i).

Platform-Specific Notes: the Git Bash on Windows line (leading-slash rewrite, the plain stderr warning for a rewritten-path argument) is retired; send writes no such warning and the line leaves the doc.
The rule that prompt text comes only from stdin or --file stands, but its Git Bash reason is gone with Windows; any text giving that reason must be re-worded or dropped.
Streams and stderr listings of send: the rewritten-path warning was the only stderr line send wrote on a rewritten path; any enumeration of send stderr output naming it is stale.

Epoch 7 PROVISIONAL marks in design-system (about five rows, including the Surface: cli OPEN on fct-bmfbeece) are discharged on the founder's own word: the socket-directory pair wording, the board read rule, the P5 word and leans, the answer-card confirm; any PROVISIONAL or OPEN mark on them is lifted.

The socket-dir-refused cause and the strict-modes refusal pairs (list board read rule, instance-state and home-state unable/hint pairs, exit 21 detail words) rest on the confirmed Epoch 7 wording; their marks change, the words do not.

viola verify step counter and summary form stamped ver n pass m fail: measured live on 2.1.287 as 23 pass 1 fail with statusline-rate-limits red; the ledger stays 24 rows, so the relied count is unchanged.

Fuel state / budget governor (5H and 7D figures, budget-paused, the BAY line): the statusline-rate-limits row it rests on reads the account plan state, not the CLI; the account payload measured five_hour unknown and only seven_day; whether the budget gate stays and what it stands on is owned by 0.2.0 (F-06i).

Verified aircraft type anchor (verified vs unverified-cli): a verify can go red on an unchanged CLI, so an unverified-cli start can follow a red verify; the live round ran one unverified wrapped start with cli_verified false.
viola list carries no link column in v1 (iconography, list columns): re-read and unmoved; v1-36, the cap about showing the link set, is deferred to 0.2.0.
Surface: cli platform line (Linux terminals, CI on ubuntu-latest): re-read and holds; CI seven jobs green on ubuntu-latest, nextest timing comments moved to the ubuntu reading.

Toolkit claim that no dependency reads a colour or terminal variable: the dependency graph moved (portable-pty 0.9.0, nix 0.28.0, serial2 and cfg_aliases added, serial family, pin-utils, termios removed); the claim is re-read on the new graph, no dependency added to the viola bin styling.
viola run prints nothing once the child starts: witnessed live on the unverified start (pty_backend openpty, the child holding fds 0-2 on the pty); unmoved.
The binary name in examples and samples is the plain name viola (EXE_SUFFIX joins and the .exe trim removed); any text allowing a viola.exe or OS-suffixed name is stale.
The near-ceiling hold and its PROVISIONAL ceiling: kept PROVISIONAL, its owner re-pointed from Version done-check to 0.2.0's first entry; any design-system text naming the done-check as owner moves.

body_fields.fact: viola verify can read red on an unchanged CLI: the statusline-rate-limits ledger row reads the account's status-line payload, which on a plan carrying only the seven-day window (five_hour unknown) fails the row, as measured on 2.1.287 (23 pass 1 fail).

body:
The 0.1.0 version done-check: every gate green on Linux (ci#42288148289 on 849aad18, seven jobs), 0.1.0 closed.
portable-pty moved =0.8.1 to =0.9.0 (nix 0.25.1 to 0.28.0, the serial family and pin-utils gone); deny.toml advisories ignore emptied, RUSTSEC-2026-0441 closed; pty_backend stays openpty.
47 Windows/macOS remnant files cleaned: plain_drive, the Git Bash rewritten-path warning in send, EXE_SUFFIX joins and the .exe trim retired; one new contract test dialog_drift_names_a_changed_annotation.
Live round on claude 2.1.287: viola verify read 23 pass 1 fail (statusline-rate-limits red, the row reads the account plan, not the CLI); the near-ceiling hold unread, so the ceiling stays PROVISIONAL owned by 0.2.0's first entry; v1-27 deferred to 0.2.0 on the founder's word.
The five one-enum error divergences ratified as named exceptions (T1); the thiserror census rule re-worded to the product sources, the count stays 9; Epoch 7's four PROVISIONAL items confirmed and their marks lifted.
The viola-pty scope entity in section 1 (fct-t2iihkln) names portable-pty =0.8.1; the pin is now =0.9.0, the openpty backend unchanged.

Span-trace coverage names portable-pty =0.8.1 for the PTY seam (fct-xrkfnxjv); the pin is now =0.9.0. Any other =0.8.1 pin or its Windows garbage-read / ConPTY-EOF rationale in obs-plan moves to =0.9.0 with no Windows reason.
Log coverage fct-yb5jpaot: the process-start claude-child field cells cut to the header's 2 cells, pty_backend carries openpty alone and sideload_fallback is gone (F434 whole-fact edit).

The PTY seam boundary wrapper and process-start claude-child rows (fct-f3gi2vhc, the process-start rows) re-read on 0.9.0: pty_backend openpty, exit from the handle wait, unchanged; a re-read, no value moved.

Error capture platform pick fct-nwrbbhk2 and fct-j5jj3gux: the thiserror type census rule is re-worded to the product sources (a grep now reads 10 rows, the 10th crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/mod.rs test-only); the count stays 9.

The five one-enum error divergences are ratified as named exceptions (T1); any obs-plan error-capture or detail-code text naming those divergences as open or unratified now reads them as named exceptions.

The near-ceiling hold ceiling stays PROVISIONAL (the hold was not read); its owner moves from Version done-check to 0.2.0's first entry; the obs-plan rows naming that ceiling and its owner (2 rows) re-point.

Epoch 7's four PROVISIONAL items are confirmed on the founder's word (the socket-directory pair's wording, the board's read rule, the unix-endpoint chunk's P5 word and leans, the 151-proposal answer-card confirm); obs-plan text carrying those PROVISIONAL marks (about 5 rows, e.g. socket-dir-refused and strict-modes wording) loses the mark, the rule itself unchanged.

Budget governor scenario and the capability ledger edge flow: the statusline-rate-limits ledger row read red on an unchanged CLI 2.1.287 because the account's payload carries five_hour unknown and only seven_day; the row reads the account's plan, the budget-paused refusal rests on it, owner 0.2.0 (finding F-06i).

Supply-chain trigger and cargo deny rule (fct-r2s52jjf, section 10 cargo deny failure condition): deny.toml advisories ignore is now empty (RUSTSEC-2017-0008 gone with serial), cargo deny reads advisories, bans, licenses, sources ok; any obs-plan mention of an ignored advisory moves to none.

The send verb no longer writes the Git Bash rewritten-path warning to stderr (send writes no stderr line on a rewritten path); any obs-plan stderr or human-output text naming that warning or plain_drive / verbatim-drive handling is retired.
The fixed binary names: EXE_SUFFIX joins are gone, the harness and tests use the plain names viola, claude, decoy-hook; any obs-plan path or artifact naming a .exe suffix is retired.

CI section 9 and multi-platform exporter trigger: matrix ubuntu-latest only, nextest timing comments now the ubuntu reading; artifacts junit-ubuntu-latest, diag-ubuntu-latest, diag-perf-ubuntu-latest, perf-ubuntu-latest, supply-chain on ci#42288148289 confirm the diag-os naming on Linux; a re-read, no rule moved.

v1-27 (cli_verified true and no viola byte on screen) deferred to 0.2.0; obs-plan text citing v1-27 or the unverified-CLI dialog branch as proved in 0.1.0 reads the verified clauses as unread, the unverified live clauses and the fake-agent half green.

body_fields.fact: The statusline-rate-limits capability-ledger row reads the account's plan state, not the CLI: on claude 2.1.287 a payload with five_hour unknown and only seven_day reads it red (verify 23 pass 1 fail); whether the budget gate stays and what it stands on is 0.2.0's (finding F-06i).

body:
The version done-check chunk moved portable-pty from =0.8.1 to =0.9.0 (nix 0.25.1 to 0.28.0, serial2 and cfg_aliases added, pin-utils and the serial crate family removed) and emptied the deny.toml advisories ignore list, the RUSTSEC-2017-0008 entry leaving with the serial crate.
It removed the Windows remnants from 47 files: plain_drive and its verbatim-drive handling, the Git Bash rewritten-path warning in send, every EXE_SUFFIX join and the .exe trim; no product surface (verb, flag, env var, channel method, log field, event kind) was added.
It added one contract test, dialog_drift_names_a_changed_annotation, and measured live on Linux with claude 2.1.287: the child's fd table holds no viola socket, socket directory 0700 and socket 0600, the child gone 0.401 s after the wrapper's SIGKILL.
The ledger row statusline-rate-limits read red on an unchanged CLI (23 pass 1 fail) because it reads the account's plan state, not the CLI; v1-27 is deferred to 0.2.0 and the hold ceiling stays PROVISIONAL, owned by 0.2.0's first entry.
The founder confirmed Epoch 7's four PROVISIONAL items and ratified the five one-enum error divergences as named exceptions; the thiserror census is re-worded to the product sources and stays 9.

Dependency Security advisories line: the RUSTSEC-2017-0008 ignore (serial via portable-pty =0.8.1) is gone; deny.toml now reads ignore = [], so the text calling it the only expected ignore, and its re-check-on-pin-move clause, is stale.
Dependency Security pinning: the portable-pty exact pin moved from =0.8.1 to =0.9.0 in workspace.dependencies; every security-plan citation of =0.8.1 is stale.
The Critical CVE response SLA and any other text naming the portable-pty to portable-pty-psmux 0.9.7 swap path: the swap trigger is spent and retired, since 0.9.0 drops pin-utils upstream.

Data Protection handle inheritance: the recorded-not-established wording and its owed measurement owned by Version done-check are discharged; the mechanism now reads portable-pty closes every inherited descriptor in the child (close_random_fds), witnessed live by the child's fd table with no viola or wrapper socket; the swap-candidate clause goes with the retired swap path.

Error Handling: the five one-enum divergences are ratified as named exceptions on the founder's word, and the thiserror derive census is re-worded to the product sources, the count staying 9 (grep reads 10 rows, the tenth test-only in crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/mod.rs).

Authentication & Authorization: an OPEN or PROVISIONAL mark resting on Epoch 7's boundary batch (the socket-directory pair wording, the board read rule, chunk 2026-11-01-unix-endpoint-and-home-hardening's word) is closed on the founder's own word; those PROVISIONAL marks are lifted.
Any security-plan row on the dialog hold ceiling: it stays PROVISIONAL (the hold was not read), its owner re-pointed from the working-route entry Version done-check to 0.2.0's first entry.
Any security-plan row on Measurement B: recorded as known with no action in 0.1.0; the pinned binary re-hash stays the guard.

Indirect, through the ledger row statusline-rate-limits: the stamp-gated dialog answering and the unverified-cli gate rest on a verify where every relied row passes; that row reads the account's status-line plan state, so verify can go red on an unchanged CLI; owner 0.2.0 (finding F-06i), with the budget-paused refusal resting on the same row.

Threat Model supply-chain boundary and the dependency graph: the serial, serial-core, serial-unix, serial-windows, ioctl-rs, termios, pin-utils and memoffset 0.6.5 crates left the graph; nix moved to 0.28.0; cargo deny check reads advisories ok, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok.

Any remaining Windows, macOS, ConPTY or Git Bash wording in security-plan (the dep-conpty subject, the 0.9.0 Windows garbage-read and ConPTY-EOF rationale): the Windows code it explained is gone and the pin comment now reads only that the workspace pins every third-party version exactly.

The version done-check for viola 0.1.0: every gate green on Linux (ci#42288148289 on 849aad18, seven jobs), the open caps ruled, the version closed; no product surface added (no verb, flag, env var, channel method, log field or event kind).
Dependency move: portable-pty =0.8.1 to =0.9.0 (nix 0.25.1 to 0.28.0, the serial crate family, pin-utils, memoffset 0.6.5 and termios gone); deny.toml advisories ignore emptied (RUSTSEC-2017-0008 left with serial), RUSTSEC-2026-0441 closed; pty_backend stays openpty, viola-pty 33 of 33 green.
Windows remnants retired across 47 files: plain_drive and its verbatim-drive handling, the Git Bash rewritten-path warning of send (emitter, unit table, CLI witness), every EXE_SUFFIX join and the .exe trim, the home.rs resolved strip; comments re-worded to the Linux/ubuntu reading.
One new contract test, tests/contract_fake_agent_drift.rs dialog_drift_names_a_changed_annotation; one harness test renamed, exe_is_the_plain_name_in_the_dir.
Live round on claude 2.1.287: viola verify read red 23 pass 1 fail (statusline-rate-limits reads the account plan, not the CLI); the unverified wrapped start and killed-wrapper leg green; the dialog hold unread, so v1-27 deferred to 0.2.0 and the hold ceiling stays PROVISIONAL, owner 0.2.0's first entry.
Founder's word discharges the Epoch 7 PROVISIONAL marks; Measurement B known with no action in 0.1.0; the census GATES 41 / 39 / 2 re-read unchanged.

The viola-pty entity and every pin line naming portable-pty =0.8.1 (fct-njspb5nv, fct-vmzc7an2, fct-tr6c4sml and the other pty-pin rows) now read =0.9.0; the entity's Source citing Windows ConPTY EOF loses its Windows reason; exit on the handle, never on EOF, stands.

The supply-chain trigger fct-hlx2zkbt says cargo deny check may only ignore RUSTSEC-2017-0008: the ignore list is now empty (ignore = [], entries 1 to 0), RUSTSEC-2026-0441 (pin-utils via nix 0.25.1) closed; any serial-ignore or pin-utils row in the detail files moves with it.

The Git Bash rewritten-path warning is retired: the trigger line naming the §6 rewritten-path warning (fct-engo5ir7) and any detail row naming the warning, its rstest table looks_rewritten_matches_only_the_git_bash_shape or the CLI witness send_rewritten_path_argument_draws_the_warning are stale; the rule that a leading-slash argument is never taken as a prompt (stdin or --file only) stands.

plain_drive and its Windows verbatim-drive handling are gone, with the rstest table plain_drive_strips_only_the_verbatim_drive_prefix; canonical_home keeps its signature; any test-plan row naming a plain_drive test is stale.

Every EXE_SUFFIX join and the .exe trim in tests/cli_output_plain.rs are removed (binaries named plain viola, claude, decoy-hook; registered paths bin/claude and target/perf/release/viola unchanged); the exe-suffix rows of test-plan move; the harness test is now exe_is_the_plain_name_in_the_dir.
tests/support/home.rs resolved no longer strips the verbatim prefix; the path oracle rule (compare resolved(home), never TestHome::path) stands but any Windows reason given for it is stale.

Windows wording standing in test-plan is a remnant: the identity floor measured on the Windows host (fct-u3dkdc2w), the perf host reading on the Windows dev host (fct-vxnii5yh), per OS in the perf table and build-failure rows (fct-yoazurel, fct-2ztzeoct), the llvm-cov Windows backslash reason of the coverage regex (fct-3mj52n2x, fct-b4avhaux), fct-hhwc4gim in the detail.

COVERAGE_IGNORE and COVERAGE_FLOORS in run/coverage.rs got comments only: the regex's four trees are byte-identical, so the rule stands, but its Windows separator rationale is now a remnant explanation.
.config/nextest.toml three-runner timing comments now carry the ubuntu reading: any test-plan row citing three runners or per-OS slow-timeout readings moves.

The trycmd and assert_cmd text in §1, §5, §6, §7, §9, §10 and keys 5-command-implementation and bootstrap-phases is to be re-worded to the literal pins (CARRY 1); trycmd 27 standing rows in test-plan.

The fd-inheritance wording (4 test-plan rows incl. key test-data-bootstrap, E2 fct-tenptmlu): portable-pty closes every inherited descriptor in the child (close_random_fds), no longer recorded, not established; witnessed by E2 and the live round's /proc fd table (31 fds, 0-2 on the pty, no viola socket, no home file).

Measurement B is recorded as known with no action in 0.1.0, the pin re-hash staying the guard: the measurement-b rows of test-plan (2) move.

The Epoch 7 PROVISIONAL marks (the socket-directory pair wording, the board read rule, the unix-endpoint chunk's P5 word, that wrap's answer-card confirm) are confirmed by the founder's word: the epoch7-prov rows of test-plan (17) lose their PROVISIONAL marks.
